archive.title: The $20 Billion Fighter Award Is Also an Industrial-Base Test
archive.dek: Boeing's F/A-XX selection is a major aircraft-development story, but the public record also points to a quieter constraint: whether facilities, suppliers and skilled people can support another advanced program at scale.
